# Men's Health

> Men's Health publishes expert-backed fitness, nutrition, health, sex, style, grooming, and weight-loss advice for men.

The site combines reported health journalism, workout programming, exercise tutorials, nutrition guidance, product recommendations, and lifestyle coverage from editors, trainers, and medical experts. It includes major editorial hubs, recurring franchises, and service content spanning training plans, recipes, sexual health, grooming, and gear.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.menshealth.com/): Homepage featuring the latest fitness, health, nutrition, style, and lifestyle stories.
- [Fitness](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/): Training advice, workout plans, exercise science, and body transformation coverage.
- [Health](https://www.menshealth.com/health/): Preventive health, conditions, mental health, sleep, and longevity reporting.
- [Nutrition](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/): Diet advice, healthy eating strategies, supplements, and recipe features.
- [Sex & Relationships](https://www.menshealth.com/sex-women/): Sex, dating, relationships, and sexual wellness coverage.
- [Style](https://www.menshealth.com/style/): Men’s fashion, wardrobe essentials, watches, and style recommendations.
- [Grooming](https://www.menshealth.com/grooming/): Skincare, haircare, shaving, beard care, and grooming product advice.
- [Technology & Gear](https://www.menshealth.com/technology-gear/): Fitness tech, gadgets, outdoor gear, and product reviews.

## Fitness & Training
- [Workouts](https://www.menshealth.com/workouts/): Workout routines, exercise collections, and training plans for strength and conditioning.
- [Fitness](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/): Broad fitness hub covering muscle building, fat loss, and performance.
- [Beginner's Guide to Weight Training](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/a27212209/beginners-guide-weight-training/): Introductory guide to lifting technique, programming, and gym fundamentals.
- [How to Build Muscle](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/a19534499/10-muscle-building-tips/): Practical muscle-building advice on training, recovery, and nutrition basics.
- [Body Recomposition](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/a63227245/body-recomposition/): Explains how to build muscle while reducing body fat.
- [Best Home Workouts](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/g19546611/best-home-workouts/): At-home training ideas requiring minimal equipment and space.
- [Best Bodyweight Exercises](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/a19547846/best-bodyweight-exercises/): Foundational bodyweight movements for strength, mobility, and conditioning.

## Health & Wellness
- [Health](https://www.menshealth.com/health/): Core health reporting on disease prevention, wellness, and healthy living.
- [Mental Health](https://www.menshealth.com/health/mental-health/): Coverage of stress, anxiety, depression, therapy, and emotional wellbeing.
- [Sleep](https://www.menshealth.com/health/sleep/): Sleep science, recovery advice, and strategies for better rest.
- [Heart Health](https://www.menshealth.com/health/heart-health/): Articles on cardiovascular risk, exercise, and prevention.
- [Health Conditions Hub](https://www.menshealth.com/health-conditions-hub/): Service content on common conditions, symptoms, and treatment topics.
- [Longevity](https://www.menshealth.com/health/a45522898/longevity/): Reporting and advice focused on healthy aging and lifespan.
- [Weight Loss](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/): Fat-loss strategies, metabolism guidance, and sustainable weight management.

## Nutrition & Diet
- [Nutrition](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/): Main nutrition hub with diet advice, food explainers, and healthy eating tips.
- [Healthy Recipes](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/g19542987/healthy-recipes/): Recipe collections designed for healthier everyday eating.
- [High-Protein Foods](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/a19543934/high-protein-foods/): Guide to protein-rich foods for muscle gain and satiety.
- [Best Healthy Snacks](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/g19544884/healthy-snacks/): Snack ideas that support fitness and nutrition goals.
- [Supplements](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/supplements/): Coverage of protein powders, creatine, vitamins, and supplement evidence.
- [Weight Loss Foods](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/g19547475/best-weight-loss-foods/): Foods commonly recommended for satiety and calorie control.
- [Meal Prep Ideas](https://www.menshealth.com/nutrition/g19542974/meal-prep-ideas/): Practical meal-prep concepts for busy schedules and fitness plans.

## Sex & Relationships
- [Sex & Women](https://www.menshealth.com/sex-women/): Main relationships and sex hub with advice and reported features.
- [Sexual Health](https://www.menshealth.com/sex-women/sexual-health/): Sexual wellness coverage including performance, safety, and common concerns.
- [Dating](https://www.menshealth.com/sex-women/dating-advice/): Dating tips, etiquette, and relationship-building advice.
- [Relationships](https://www.menshealth.com/sex-women/relationships/): Long-term relationship guidance, communication, and intimacy topics.
- [Erectile Dysfunction](https://www.menshealth.com/health/a19547421/erectile-dysfunction/): Overview content on ED causes, treatment, and when to seek care.
- [How to Last Longer in Bed](https://www.menshealth.com/sex-women/a19547417/how-to-last-longer-in-bed/): Practical sexual wellness advice focused on stamina and confidence.

- [Best Face Moisturizers for Men](https://www.menshealth.com/grooming/g19547458/best-face-moisturizers-for-men/): Skincare product recommendations for hydration and daily use.

## Weight Loss & Body Composition
- [Weight Loss](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/): Dedicated hub for fat loss, metabolism, and sustainable body-change advice.
- [How to Lose Belly Fat](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/a19537264/how-to-lose-belly-fat/): Evidence-based guidance on reducing abdominal fat over time.
- [Best Weight Loss Foods](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/g19547475/best-weight-loss-foods/): Food choices commonly recommended for satiety and calorie control.
- [Body Recomposition](https://www.menshealth.com/fitness/a63227245/body-recomposition/): Strategy guide for gaining muscle while leaning out.
- [Metabolism Explained](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/a19537273/metabolism/): Explainer on metabolism, calorie burn, and common misconceptions.
- [How Many Calories Should I Eat to Lose Weight?](https://www.menshealth.com/weight-loss/a19537271/how-many-calories-should-i-eat-to-lose-weight/): Calorie-planning guidance for sustainable fat loss.
